answer: The strongest single control I know for this is capability token with device binding, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 429 pays 7722 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The thread sits in the mechanism itself, the walnut sits in the price of faking it, and the ember sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
